chunks: People used to perform istinja with stones, and a man from the Ansar ate some food, so his stomach became loose, and he performed istinja with water. Then Allah, Blessed and Exalted, revealed concerning him:
"Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves."

So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله called him, and the man feared that something displeasing had been revealed about him. When he entered, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to him, "Have you done anything on this day of yours?" He said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, I ate some food, and my stomach became loose, so I performed istinja with water."

So he said to him, "Rejoice, for Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has revealed concerning you: 'Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.' So you were the first of the repentant and the first of those who purify themselves."

key_terms.التَّوَّابِينَ: those who repeatedly repent and turn back to Allah
key_terms.الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ: those who purify themselves physically and ritually
key_terms.بِالْأَحْجَارِ: with stones, the earlier method of cleaning after relieving oneself
key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, indicating purification by washing
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted is He, a formula of glorification for Allah
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجُونَ: they performed istinja, cleansing oneself after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What is the occasion of revelation for "Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves"?
ai.summary: This report explains an occasion connected to the verse declaring Allah’s love for those who repent and purify themselves. It highlights purification with water after relieving oneself and presents the verse as praise for both inward repentance and outward cleanliness.
